notes: Both lakem phrases are recast as English possessives, so each lamed is unrepresented and each suffix takes your (rules 18, 40).
al-yede Edom is read as the preposition taking along by and the construct noun taking the side; heading al on along rather than by is the point of choice (rule 8).
The article on ha-melach takes the written the, which English fronts before the attributively rendered Salt (rule 29).
